claims.unit: share of rides served, charging in order of arrival less emptiest battery first
claims.conditions: 1,000 vehicles on one feeder, a site short of power; the cadence setting E22 chose, each fortnight replayed until the fleet settles and its last week scored; median and 10th to 90th percentile of 4 fortnights by 10 draws. Where power is not short the two rules serve the same rides

figures: 90% of usable power at the estimate
claims.unit: vehicles to plan one 2.75 MW feeder for
claims.conditions: the largest fleet carried at the estimated energy use and, in each of the four fortnights taken alone, with driving energy and the always-on load 10% higher. E26's registered rule, the largest fleet carried at both levels over all forty runs, gives 625; 25 rides offered a vehicle a day; a vehicle is called in once a charger is free for it; the cadence setting E22 chose, each fortnight replayed until the fleet settles and its last week scored; 4 fortnights by 10 draws

figures: 61% of visits start on a low battery at the limit
claims.unit: vehicles on one 2.75 MW feeder at the estimated energy use
claims.conditions: carried: the largest fleet serving 99% of rides in nine runs in ten with no more than half its depot visits arriving at the low-battery level; the largest fleet run that was carried, in steps of 25 vehicles. Served at the limit: the largest fleet serving 99% in nine runs in ten on any terms. 25 rides offered a vehicle a day; a vehicle is called in once a charger is free for it; the cadence setting E22 chose, each fortnight replayed until the fleet settles and its last week scored; 4 fortnights by 10 draws
claims.source: E23, E25 and E26, data/derived/e23_capacity.json, e25_between.json and e26_margin.json

claims.unit: vehicles carried on one feeder with the vehicles' energy use 10% lower and 10% higher than estimated
claims.conditions: driving energy and the always-on load both multiplied; the capacity test's setting; 4 fortnights by 10 draws

claims.unit: largest fleet carried on one feeder, by calling rule, on the same steps
claims.conditions: both rules on steps of 50 vehicles at the estimated energy use; the rule that waits was not run above the last shared step here, where finer steps carry 675; 4 fortnights by 10 draws

claims.unit: share of rides served at 1,000 vehicles on one feeder, by power rule
claims.conditions: a plain threshold; the cadence setting E22 chose, each fortnight replayed until the fleet settles and its last week scored; median of 4 fortnights by 10 draws

figures: 2.0% a month since the footprint last changed
claims.unit: months until the 20 km area needs more vehicles than one feeder is planned for
claims.conditions: against the 600 vehicles planned; a scenario, not a test. Today's level read two ways (the last four quarters, centred on January 2026, and the latest quarter, centred on May 2026), so the months count from the first half of 2026. Growth: the fit to monthly trips since the served footprint last changed (2025-10 to 2026-06), which agrees with the slowest of E21's three readings; the two faster readings span the quarter the footprint was enlarged and are quoted as what such a jump would do again. Statewide trips a resident applied to the East Bay's residents, with no adjustment for density
claims.source: E21 and the account study, data/derived/e21_demand.json and account_study.json

figures: $4 to $10 million at a lead of 4 years
claims.unit: dollars of contribution not earned by applying a year after signing, present value
claims.conditions: a table of scenarios with no bars: two readings of today, three of growth, lead times of two, three and four years, discount rates of 8% and 10%, and the two unsourced vehicle costs at the cheap end, the base and the dear end of their ranges; a vehicle the first feeder cannot carry is valued at what a second feeder would add for it, the land and first connection being paid already; capped at one feeder's worth of vehicles; every vehicle assumed to find its rides

claims.unit: vehicles carried on one feeder with the always-on load counted while a vehicle is in the depot, and with 10% more energy use on the road as well
claims.conditions: the always-on load charged to a vehicle's battery for every minute between arriving at the depot and leaving it; the capacity test's setting; 4 fortnights by 10 draws. Carried in every fortnight applies the rule to each fortnight alone

claims.unit: vehicles carried on one feeder with one input moved further than the earlier tests moved it
claims.conditions: the capacity test's setting and the rule that waits for a free charger, on its four fortnights with three of its ten seeds, twelve runs a fleet; one input moved at a time; at 30 rides a vehicle a day no fleet from 525 to 600 is carried and smaller fleets were not run

claims.unit: what the hourly plan pays for energy at 600 vehicles, less than the rule that waits for a free charger
claims.conditions: the capacity test's setting under the plan on 30-minute slots, four fortnights with three of its ten seeds; the rule that waits is read from E23 on the same fortnights and seeds

figures: 25 vehicles added by a quarter more chargers
claims.unit: vehicles: the planner's arithmetic for East Oakland, and the largest fleet carried with an operating rule taken away
claims.conditions: `depot-twin plan` on sites/east_oakland.toml and sites/shape_*.toml: four windows a site, two draws a window, a search in steps of 25, carried in every window. A check of the planner against the study and of the fleet against other demand, with no bars

claims.unit: how many independent runs the forty runs of a capacity figure are worth
claims.conditions: a one-way split of the spread of rides served between the fortnight replayed and the draw within it, at every fleet and rule where rides served moves; each fortnight is scaled to the same rides a vehicle a day, and all four are from March to May 2024 in San Francisco

claims.unit: vehicles the 20 km area would keep busy today
claims.conditions: San Francisco's rides a resident, as the average of the last four quarters and as the latest quarter, applied to the East Bay's residents at 25 rides a vehicle a day; an upper reading, with no adjustment for lower density
